about: Vertices of the purchased model moved apart where two of its faces draw differently in one plane (tools/build/fabcoincident.py --measure; read by src/model/coincident.ts at load). Back-to-back faces move out along their own fronts; of two facing the same way the rarer material is laid over the other.
frame: moves: flat [vertex, dx, dy, dz] rows, vertex index into the mesh's POSITION, displacement in micrometres of the game frame (ship frame); the runtime checks name, pointer, material and counts
